text_block_list.text:
It's fall, and Эль Кондор Паса's friends,
Special
Week and Грасс Вандер, have
grown
significantly.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The three of them put on a special event
for their
fans, including a concert, and
then El Condor
Pasa challenges the
other two in the talk show
afterwards.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's decided that Эль Кондор Паса will face
off
against Спешл Уик in the Japan
Cup and Grass
Wonder in the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All three runners are determined to
deliver
incredible performances for the
audience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
